pallets.noteEn: Assumes a usable load height of 165 cm (180 cm overall minus the 14.4 cm pallet) and the EPAL dynamic rating of 1,500 kg. Adjust for your racking or trailer height limits.
pallets.noteZh: 假設可用堆疊高度 165 cm(整體 180 cm 減 14.4 cm 卡板),EPAL 動態載重 1,500 kg。請按你嘅貨架或車廂高度限制調整。

pallets.labelZh: 美式 GMA 卡板 (48×40 吋)
pallets.noteEn: 48×40 in = 121.9×101.6 cm. Assumes a 152 cm usable load height (60 in overall) and the commonly cited ~2,500 lb (1,134 kg) dynamic rating — verify your pallet spec.
pallets.noteZh: 48×40 吋 = 121.9×101.6 cm。假設可用高度 152 cm(整體 60 吋),常見動態載重約 2,500 磅(1,134 kg)— 以實際卡板規格為準。

pallets.noteEn: Assumes a 165 cm usable load height and a 1,500 kg dynamic rating — verify against your pallet spec and racking limits.
pallets.noteZh: 假設可用高度 165 cm、動態載重 1,500 kg — 以實際卡板規格同貨架限制為準。

trucks.noteEn: Typical 53' dry-van interior dimensions; payload varies by tractor, axles and carrier — confirm before booking.
trucks.noteZh: 53 呎乾貨掛車典型內籠尺寸;載重視乎車頭、車軸同承運人 — 訂車前請確認。

trucks.noteEn: Typical 13.6 m tautliner interior; ~24 t payload is a common figure — confirm with your carrier and route weight limits.
trucks.noteZh: 13.6 米篷布半掛車典型內籠;載重約 24 噸屬常見數字 — 以承運人同路線限重為準。

trucks.noteEn: Typical 26 ft box truck interior; payload varies widely by chassis (often 4–5 t) — verify your vehicle's rating.
trucks.noteZh: 26 呎箱車典型內籠;載重因車架差異大(常見 4–5 噸)— 以實際車輛規格為準。
